name: audit-log-service
summary: Append-only audit trail of business decisions. Keywords: audit, compliance, history

name: booking-service
summary: Interest, bookings, cancel, move, check-in, attendance (attended / no-show / not eligible); event reminders; closes events. Keywords: rsvp, attendance, kiosk, walk-in

name: campaign-service
summary: Announcements, filtered invitations, broadcasts and social posts to audiences. Keywords: campaign, marketing, broadcast, audience

name: checklist-service
summary: Reusable checklists (playbooks) applied to any target as dated tasks; idempotent. Keywords: playbook, template tasks

name: event-report-service
summary: Event outcome stats (funnel, fill and show rate, optional breakdown) and retrospectives. Keywords: report, retro, analytics

name: event-service
summary: Events: create/edit/clone, pictures, complete/reopen; optional time slots and checklist. Keywords: event, session, workshop, class, camp

name: access-service
summary: Role ladder (from config roles:), volunteer roles, permission catalogue, personal permissions, effective permissions. Keywords: rbac, authorization, staff

name: auth-service
summary: Login credentials, sessions (JWT), password change/reset links. Keywords: login, password, token, authentication

name: lead-service
summary: Enquiries from a product's public website (request a demo, contact us): kept as leads the platform operator follows up (new, contacted, won, lost) and announced by email to the addresses the deployment names. Keywords: lead, enquiry, demo request, contact form, sales, CRM

name: media-service
summary: Image uploads → resized WebP in local/S3 storage. Keywords: image, photo, upload, picture, avatar

name: notification-service
summary: Sends email/SMS/WhatsApp from templates with admin on/off + channel settings; circuit breaker per channel. Keywords: message, email, sms, whatsapp

name: ops-monitor-service
summary: Read-only live operations screen: every request and verdict as it happens, traces, service health, headline numbers and a live map of places (all set by the deployment's monitor: section). Keywords: monitor, ops, live, map, wall screen, command centre, dashboard, trace, observability

name: people-service
summary: Generic person records: name, email, phone, photo, invite/referral code, calendar token; product fields via a profile plugin. Keywords: person, profile, contact, member

name: questionnaire-service
summary: Screening questionnaires and chat flows; the rules come from the product. Keywords: screening, chatbot, quiz, eligibility

name: recognition-service
summary: Certificates and vouchers for people who attended a completed event. Keywords: certificate, voucher, reward

name: referral-service
summary: Invite-a-friend points (weights in config) and leaderboard. Keywords: referral, leaderboard, invite

name: scheduler-service
summary: Recurring/daily schedules that emit ticks to target services. Keywords: cron, job, reminder, timer

name: settings-service
summary: Admin-editable settings (integrations, message policies, screen options); secrets stay sealed. Keywords: settings, configuration, integrations, credentials, smtp, twilio, api keys

name: slot-service
summary: Time slots per event with capacity rules. Keywords: booking slots, capacity, appointment

name: task-service
summary: Tasks with owners, due dates, board states, history; due-soon reminders. Keywords: todo, planning, kanban, reminder

name: template-service
summary: Message templates per product + admin custom wording with safe {placeholders}. Keywords: wording, automatic messages

name: business-service
summary: Businesses (each one a separate tenant: currency, time zone, modules on/off, planning and costing settings) and their locations (kitchen, warehouse, store, truck; holding place, days of cover, count frequency). Keywords: tenant, company, site, outlet, store, warehouse, settings, modules

name: closing-service
summary: End-of-day staff closing at a location: staff name, date, issues, counted stock (shown next to what the system expects) and sales by type; a submitted closing replaces system stock with the count. Keywords: end of day, shift close, stocktake, cash-up, daily report

name: costing-service
summary: Cost of goods sold for every count period (ingredient cost used / sales), costing average with labour, rent and other costs, acceptable COGS range alert, monthly summary with net profit that is never shown while a cost line is missing. Keywords: COGS, food cost, margin, profit and loss, P&L, overheads, labour, rent

name: delivery-service
summary: Delivery runs: a driver's warehouse-out trips in stop order with estimated arrival times, on-the-road status, proof of delivery (receiver name and signature) and failed stops that go back to be planned again. Keywords: delivery, route, run, driver, stop, ETA, proof of delivery, POD, signature, dispatch

name: inventory-service
summary: Inventory control: minimum and maximum (par) levels per item and location, daily alerts for low, negative, expiring and expired stock sent to the owners, full stock takes with variance, stock valuation (current cost and by lot), ABC analysis, days of cover and waste by reason. Keywords: par level, reorder point, min max, low stock alert, expiry alert, stock take, cycle count, variance, shrinkage, valuation, FIFO, ABC analysis, days of cover, waste report

name: item-service
summary: What a food business buys, makes and sells: items (ingredient, finished product, supply) with unit and cost, suppliers, simple recipes (output of one batch + optional ingredient list). Keywords: product, ingredient, sku, supplier, vendor, recipe, batch, cost

name: planning-service
summary: Recommendations from past usage: weekly production target (finished goods, batches, ingredients to buy), warehouse out (what to send each location for its days of cover), warehouse in (what the holding place needs for the week), reorder quantities per supplier with the previous recommendation and large changes flagged; manual targets when there is no history. Keywords: forecast, par level, replenishment, reorder point, production plan, demand

name: purchase-service
summary: Purchase orders to suppliers: save, change, copy, cancel, receive in full or with changed quantities (receipt adds stock at the holding place); ready-to-send text for WhatsApp. Keywords: PO, supplier order, procurement, receiving, goods in

name: stock-service
summary: Stock of every item at every location and the movement history behind it (receive, warehouse out, transfer, production, ingredient use, adjustment with reason, count). Every change records who, when, why and the unit cost; history is append-only. Keywords: inventory, stock level, ledger, transfer, adjustment, stocktake, count

name: warehouse-service
summary: Warehouse floor: bins and zones, lots with expiry dates that follow every stock movement first-expiry-first-out, pick lists that become a warehouse-out when picked, putaway. Keywords: bin, zone, lot, batch, expiry, FEFO, pick list, putaway, shelf life
